scripts.test: pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/domain test && pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/database test && pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/api test && pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/worker test && pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/rule-proof test && node --test tests/integration/*.test.ts && node --test tests/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @genesis-shopify/admin build && npm --prefix apps/shopify/genesis-trade-suite run build && pnpm exec shopify app build --path apps/shopify/genesis-trade-suite
scripts.shopify:dev: pnpm exec shopify app dev --path apps/shopify/genesis-trade-suite --store displaydeck.myshopify.com
